title.zh: Coinbase Gets CFTC Approval For Its Own USDC-Native Clearinghouse

current_state.zh: Coinbase received CFTC approval to run its own USDC-native clearinghouse, enabling the exchange to clear its derivatives trades with stablecoin-based collateral under US regulation.
